credits.overview: A devoted father’s dream of providing a better life for his family turns into a living nightmare when their newly purchased suburban home becomes the target of escalating supernatural terror and dark neighborhood secrets.

credits.title: Difraction
credits.overview: Depicting the dynamics of a location that conventionally connects two points that are often crowded with people. Through the action of commotion, intimate conversations, and meeting new people, all of which are captured from one point of view and rolling without cuts.

credits.overview: Firman, a closeted gay actor, tries to maintain his image while being interviewed for his upcoming movie, but his stance on a case involving a fellow queer friend might jeopardise it.

credits.overview: When a teen girl is possessed by a singing spirit after visiting the mystical Watu Kandang, her disturbing behavior brings turmoil to the village.

credits.overview: Five music videos from five songs from Efek Rumah Kaca’s latest album, Rimpang. Following their music video screening, Efek Rumah Kaca will present a live performance of their latest album in the cinema.

credits.title: Status Quo
credits.overview: Interfaith couple who have been dating for a long time talks about the future of their relationship. What will happen next?

credits.overview: A woman tries to escape from a wrapped ghost, Pocong, by hiding in a man’s house. Later, she realizes that the man is scarier than the Pocong itself.

credits.title: Galang
credits.overview: Her sister's tragic death in an underground music concert made Galang devastated and searched for the cause until he finally met Asmara, the manager of her sister's favorite band who happened to be performing at the same concert when her sister died. Will Galang take revenge or will he find his true identity?

credits.title: Myth of Cannon
credits.overview: A husband and wife have been wanting a baby for a long time so they perform a ritual that is believed to bring good things.

credits.title: The Red Point of Marriage
credits.overview: A couple's relationship hits rock bottom after 11 years – until an intriguing young woman reawakens emotions and threatens to end their marriage.

credits.title: Along the Road

credits.title: Unhappy Together
credits.overview: A Man and a Woman were smoking together on the side of the road. They were arguing in an emotionless voices. As the night went, a hidden secret was revealed.

credits.overview: 7 Anak Garuda face conflict in the absence of their mentor in Europe as they struggle to work through their differences to make this expensive trip their most memorable one.

credits.title: At Stake
credits.overview: Four brothers Ibra, Elzan, Amar, and Ical attempting to collect money for their father's medical bills. Always in stalemate, the brothers eventually took a very reckless decision.
